title: HISS policy-kernel verification package (exhaustive, SMT, mutation, property-based and Cedar/OPA differential checks)
description: Deterministic scripts that evaluate a minimum-necessary access-policy kernel over its full input space (73,440 requests) against seven safety properties and a utility criterion, with baselines, mutation analysis, a Z3 cross-check, a Hypothesis baseline and a Cedar/OPA differential check. Synthetic data only.
